undeclared.decision: When ReadX categories and the Zotero mirror’s collections both change, the ReadX-derived collection list replaces the mirror edit without checking for a conflict.
undeclared.why_it_matters: The mirror editor permits collection edits. A simultaneous ReadX category change can therefore silently discard that edit and later push the overwritten value, contrary to A-017.

undeclared.decision: After an attachment disappears from the latest snapshot, parent document mappings and collection document mappings are rebuilt using only current snapshot attachments.
undeclared.why_it_matters: A retained local paper can keep its old shelf label while its key disappears from the collection’s document list. A subsequent collection write may then omit that paper’s deny policy from authorization checks, contrary to A-016. The added history test removes a non-PDF attachment, so it does not exercise this mapping case.

stale_rows.mismatch: The simultaneous-edit conflict checks cover title, DOI, venue, authors, year, and note content, but not collection membership.
Collection policy scope can omit a retained paper after its attachment disappears from a later snapshot.

resolved_previous: A-001 shelf-delete race: deletion and membership updates now serialize; stale assignments are rejected, with a regression test.
A-007/A-018 attachment history: prior files absent from a later snapshot remain in the export, with a regression test.
A-007/A-020 snapshot cap: the 5,000-object limit was removed and a test covers more than 5,000 items.
A-010 unsupported image formats: the ledger now specifies supported raster formats and the viewer shows an omission placeholder, with a regression test.
